Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

This role will support the Dashboard Team at FundPartner Solutions , focusing on the development and implementation of dashboard projects related to fund reporting. The position involves close collaboration with fund operations teams to identify, define, and deliver effective data visualization and reporting solutions. Core responsibilities include designing, testing, and deploying dashboards and data visualizations, primarily using Tableau, as well as managing related databases.

Your role

• Identify and analyze reporting and operational monitoring needs in collaboration with business teams.
• Define the necessary data structures in partnership with data teams.
• Design, adapt, and publish dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Tableau.
• Ensure quality control through data checks, testing, and regular feedback on new dashboard features.

Your profile

Education:

• Master’s degree in a technical discipline (digital transformation, information management, statistics, or equivalent).

Requested experience:

• Experience in the investment fund sector is preferred.

Technical skills:

• Proven experience in developing dashboards and visualizations with Tableau, including integration of custom scripts (Python, SAS, etc.).

• Proficiency in data cleaning, management, and analysis.

• Interest in innovative methods for collecting, analyzing, presenting, and disseminating information.

• Advanced proficiency in MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Soft skills:

• Strong problem-solving skills and experience in project management.

• Excellent organizational skills, rigor, and attention to detail.

• Versatility, proactivity, and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

• Team spirit, professionalism, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

Language skills:

• Fluency in spoken and written English; French is an advantage.

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

La tua squadra

Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 30 sedi in centri finanziari in tutto il mondo, e attualmente impiega oltre 5200 persone. Pictet è presente dal 1989 a Lussemburgo, dove occupa oltre 700 persone.

FundPartner Solutions offre una suite completa di servizi di gestione fondi e private label. Il team globale di esperti del settore si specializza nella domiciliazione dei fondi, registrazione e governance, così come nel rispetto dei rischi e nei servizi di gestione degli investimenti.

Le operazioni forniscono un trattamento sicuro ed efficiente delle transazioni bancarie e dei fondi di investimento di Pictet. I nostri team assicurano che tutte le attività seguano le normative e gestiscano i rischi. Sviluppando e mantenendo un'infrastruttura moderna e robusta, garantiamo servizi affidabili e di alta qualità per la gestione della ricchezza Pictet, la gestione degli asset e i clienti immobiliari.

Questo ruolo sosterrà il Dashboard Team di FundPartner Solutions , focalizzandosi sullo sviluppo e l'implementazione di progetti di dashboard relativi alla raccolta fondi. La posizione prevede una stretta collaborazione con i team di operazioni di fondo per identificare, definire e fornire soluzioni di visualizzazione e reporting dati efficaci. Le responsabilità principali includono la progettazione, il test e la distribuzione di dashboard e visualizzazioni dei dati, principalmente utilizzando Tableau, nonché la gestione di database correlati.

Il tuo ruolo

• Identificare e analizzare le esigenze di reporting e monitoraggio operativo in collaborazione con i team aziendali.
• Definire le strutture di dati necessarie in collaborazione con i team di dati.
• Progettare, adattare e pubblicare dashboard, report e visualizzazioni dei dati utilizzando Tableau.
• Assicurare il controllo della qualità attraverso controlli, test e feedback regolari sulle nuove funzionalità del cruscotto.

Il tuo profilo

Istruzione:

• Laurea magistrale in disciplina tecnica (trasformazione digitale, gestione dell’informazione, statistica o equivalente).

Esperienza richiesta:

• L'esperienza nel settore dei fondi di investimento è preferita.

Competenze tecniche:

• Provata esperienza nello sviluppo di dashboard e visualizzazioni con Tableau, compresa l'integrazione di script personalizzati (Python, SAS, ecc.).

• Competenza nella pulizia, gestione e analisi dei dati.

• Interesse a metodi innovativi per raccogliere, analizzare, presentare e diffondere informazioni.

• Capacità avanzata negli strumenti di MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Morbide competenze:

• Forte capacità di problem solving e esperienza nella gestione del progetto.

• Eccellente capacità organizzative, rigore e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Versatilità, proattività e capacità di gestire più attività contemporaneamente.

• Spirito di squadra, professionalità e capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo.

Capacità linguistiche:

• Fluenza in inglese parlato e scritto; il francese è un vantaggio.

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV da agenzie.

Ai sensi delle disposizioni della legge lussemburghese del 23 luglio 2016 che modifica la legge del 29 marzo 2013, i candidati possono essere tenuti a fornire un estratto dal loro registro penale. Questo documento, rilasciato dalle autorità, non deve essere più vecchio di tre mesi. Tale documento sarà richiesto con l'obiettivo di effettuare un controllo del carattere sui candidati, tenendo presente l'area di attività del nostro stabilimento e, più in particolare, i compiti descritti nella descrizione del lavoro.

Die Pictet Group ist einer der weltweit führenden unabhängigen Vermögensverwalter. Die 1805 gegründete Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, ist in 30 Büros in Finanzzentren weltweit vertreten und beschäftigt derzeit über 5200 Mitarbeiter. Pictet ist seit 1989 in Luxemburg präsent und beschäftigt dort über 700 Mitarbeiter.

FundPartner Solutions bietet eine vollständige Suite von Fondsverwaltungs- und Private-Label-Fondsdiensten. Das globale Team von Branchenexperten ist spezialisiert auf Fondsdomizilierung, Registrierung und Governance sowie Risk Compliance und Investment Management Services.

Operationen bieten eine sichere und effiziente Verarbeitung der Bankgeschäfte und Investmentfonds von Pictet. Unsere Teams stellen sicher, dass alle Aktivitäten den Vorschriften entsprechen und Risiken managen. Durch die Entwicklung und Pflege einer modernen, robusten Infrastruktur garantieren wir zuverlässige, qualitativ hochwertige Dienstleistungen für Pictet Wealth Management, Asset Management und Immobilienkunden.

Diese Rolle wird das Dashboard-Team von FundPartner Solutions unterstützen und sich auf die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Dashboard-Projekten im Zusammenhang mit der Fondsberichterstattung konzentrieren. Die Position umfasst eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fondsbetriebsteams, um effektive Datenvisualisierungs- und Berichtslösungen zu identifizieren, zu definieren und bereitzustellen. Zu den Hauptaufgaben gehören das Entwerfen, Testen und Bereitstellen von Dashboards und Datenvisualisierungen, hauptsächlich mit Tableau, sowie das Verwalten verwandter Datenbanken.

Deine Rolle

• Identifizierung und Analyse von Berichts- und Betriebsüberwachungsanforderungen in Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsteams.
• Definieren Sie die notwendigen Datenstrukturen in Partnerschaft mit Datenteams.
• Entwerfen, Anpassen und Veröffentlichen von Dashboards, Berichten und Datenvisualisierungen mit Tableau.
• Gewährleistung der Qualitätskontrolle durch Datenprüfungen, Tests und regelmäßiges Feedback zu neuen Dashboard-Funktionen.

Dein Profil

Bildung:

• Master-Abschluss in einer technischen Disziplin (digitale Transformation, Informationsmanagement, Statistik oder gleichwertig).

Geforderte Erfahrung:

• Erfahrung im Investmentfondssektor wird bevorzugt.

Technische Fähigkeiten:

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Dashboards und Visualisierungen mit Tableau, einschließlich der Integration von benutzerdefinierten Skripten (Python, SAS usw.).

• Kenntnisse in Datenbereinigung, -management und -analyse.

• Interesse an innovativen Methoden zur Sammlung, Analyse, Präsentation und Verbreitung von Informationen.

• Erweiterte Kenntnisse in MS Office-Tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Soft Skills:

• Starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Projektmanagement.

• Hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten, Strenge und Liebe zum Detail.

Vielseitigkeit, Proaktivität und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig zu verwalten.

• Teamgeist, Professionalität und Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch kooperativ zu arbeiten.

Sprachkenntnisse:

• fließend in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch; Französisch ist ein Vorteil.

Anmerkung:

Wir werden keine Lebensläufe von Agenturen akzeptieren.

Gemäß den Bestimmungen des luxemburgischen Gesetzes vom 23. Juli 2016 zur Änderung des Gesetzes vom 29. März 2013 kann von Bewerbern verlangt werden, einen Auszug aus ihrem Strafregister vorzulegen. Dieses von den Behörden ausgestellte Dokument darf nicht älter als drei Monate sein. Ein solches Dokument wird mit dem Ziel angefordert, eine Charakterprüfung der Kandidaten unter Berücksichtigung des Tätigkeitsbereichs unserer Einrichtung und insbesondere der in der Stellenbeschreibung beschriebenen Aufgaben durchzuführen.

Flexible und moderne Arbeitsweisen

Als verantwortungsbewusster und unterstützender Arbeitgeber fördern wir das Wohlergehen unserer Mitarbeiter durch eine Reihe flexibler Arbeitsvereinbarungen, die von einer Work-from-Home-Politik für förderfähige Funktionen bis hin zu Möglichkeiten für einen annualisierten Teilzeiturlaub und einen verlängerten Elternurlaub reichen.

Le groupe Pictet est l'un des leaders mondiaux des gestionnaires de patrimoine et d'actifs indépendants. Fondé en 1805 et ayant son siège social à Genève, le Groupe est représenté dans 30 bureaux dans les centres financiers du monde entier et emploie actuellement plus de 5200 personnes. Pictet est présent depuis 1989 au Luxembourg, où il emploie plus de 700 personnes.

FundPartner Solutions offre une gamme complète de services d'administration de fonds et de fonds de marques privées. L'équipe mondiale d'experts de l'industrie se spécialise dans la domiciliation des fonds, l'enregistrement et la gouvernance, ainsi que dans la conformité aux risques et les services de gestion des investissements.

Les opérations assurent un traitement sûr et efficace des transactions bancaires et des fonds d'investissement de Pictet. Nos équipes s'assurent que toutes les activités suivent les règlements et gèrent les risques. En développant et en maintenant une infrastructure moderne et robuste, nous garantissons des services fiables et de haute qualité pour la gestion de patrimoine, la gestion d'actifs et les clients immobiliers de Pictet.

Ce rôle appuiera l'équipe du tableau de bord de FundPartner Solutions , en mettant l'accent sur l'élaboration et la mise en œuvre de projets du tableau de bord liés à la présentation de rapports sur les fonds. Le poste comprend une collaboration étroite avec les équipes opérationnelles du fonds afin d'identifier, de définir et de fournir des solutions efficaces de visualisation et de communication des données. Les principales responsabilités comprennent la conception, l'essai et le déploiement de tableaux de bord et de visualisations de données, principalement à l'aide de Tableau, ainsi que la gestion de bases de données connexes.

Votre rôle

• Identifier et analyser les besoins en matière de rapports et de suivi opérationnel en collaboration avec les équipes d'affaires.
• Définir les structures de données nécessaires en partenariat avec les équipes de données.
• Concevoir, adapter et publier des tableaux de bord, des rapports et des visualisations de données à l'aide de Tableau.
• Assurer le contrôle de la qualité par la vérification des données, les tests et la rétroaction régulière sur les nouvelles fonctionnalités du tableau de bord.

Votre profil

Éducation:

• Maîtrise dans une discipline technique (transformation numérique, gestion de l'information, statistiques ou équivalent).

Expérience demandée:

• L'expérience du secteur des fonds d'investissement est privilégiée.

Compétences techniques:

• Expérience éprouvée dans le développement de tableaux de bord et de visualisations avec Tableau, y compris l'intégration de scripts personnalisés (Python, SAS, etc.).

• Compétence en nettoyage, gestion et analyse des données.

• Intérêt pour des méthodes innovantes de collecte, d'analyse, de présentation et de diffusion de l'information.

• Compétences avancées en outils MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Compétences douces :

• Des compétences et une expérience solides en gestion de projet.

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles, rigueur et attention aux détails.

• Polyvalence, proactivité et capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs tâches.

• esprit d'équipe, professionnalisme et capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en collaboration.

Compétences linguistiques :

• Le français est un avantage.

Remarque

Nous n'accepterons aucun CV des agences.

Conformément aux dispositions de la loi luxembourgeoise du 23 juillet 2016 modifiant la loi du 29 mars 2013, les candidats peuvent être tenus de fournir un extrait de leur casier judiciaire. Ce document, délivré par les autorités, ne doit pas dépasser trois mois. Un tel document sera demandé dans le but de vérifier le caractère des candidats, en tenant compte du domaine d'activité de notre établissement et, plus particulièrement, des tâches décrites dans la description de travail.

Méthodes de travail flexibles et modernes

En tant qu'employeur responsable et solidaire, nous favorisons le bien-être de nos employés au moyen d'un ensemble d'arrangements de travail flexibles, allant d'une politique du travail à la maison pour les fonctions admissibles à des possibilités de congé annuel à temps partiel et de congé parental prolongé.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Asset Management manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions,financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service.

The Investment Reporting team serves institutional clients and financial intermediaries through three core pillars: producing high‑quality client and marketing documents; promoting an exceptional client experience by providing customized and timely solutions; and innovating to continuously improve how documents are designed, produced and distributed.

Your role

Production of documents

• Deliver high‑quality investment reports, marketing materials and client presentations with a strong focus on accuracy, consistency and timeliness.

• Own end‑to‑end production topics: manage priorities with stakeholders,anticipate bottlenecks, and ensure reliable delivery during peak periods.

• Contribute to strengthening production robustness through ongoing process improvements.

• Play an integral role in the migration of existing reports to the Vermilion Reporting Suite (VRS) and the transition of our data to Snowflake.

Client Experience Enhancement

• Improve client satisfaction by raising quality standards and service responsiveness.

• Evolve reports, templates and content to enhance investment insights, increase clarity, storytelling and visual impact for our clients.

• Partner with Sales and Investment teams for client meetings/reviews and translate feedback into concrete improvements in reporting output and service practices.

Reporting Innovation

• Identify pragmatic opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate recurring tasks to improve efficiency and quality at scale by using technology.

Your profile

We’re looking for a proactive, motivated and skilled individual who brings analytical thinking, technical skills to support modern reporting, a client mindset, and a collaborative approach. The ideal candidate will have:

• A university degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics , or a related field.

• A solid understanding of financial markets , with experience in investment reporting / client reporting or a similar environment with a strong focus on Fixed Income and Multi-Asset.

• Strong analytical problem-solving skills , high attention to detail , and a proven quality mindset.

• Comfortable working independently , taking ownership, and collaborating effectively across teams and locations.

• Ability to translate complex investment data into clear, visually compelling client-facing material.

• Advanced SQL, Excel and PowerPoint.

• Experience with VRS / Snowflake / Tableau is a strong asset.

• Strong interest in new technology and AI / GenAI, applied to automation, quality controls and innovation generation, Python highly valued.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

La tua squadra

Pictet Asset Management gestisce i beni di alcune delle più grandi istituzioni del mondo, intermediari finanziari e loro clienti. La nostra cultura accoglie pensatori e centri indipendenti intorno all'eccellenza degli investimenti, una prospettiva a lungo termine e una dedizione al servizio clienti.

Il team Investment Reporting serve clienti istituzionali e intermediari finanziari attraverso tre pilastri principali: la produzione di documenti di alta qualità cliente e marketing; la promozione di un'esperienza cliente eccezionale fornendo soluzioni personalizzate e tempestive; e l'innovazione per migliorare continuamente come i documenti sono progettati, prodotti e distribuiti.

Il tuo ruolo

Produzione di documenti

• Fornire rapporti di investimento di alta qualità, materiali di marketing e presentazioni dei clienti con un forte focus su accuratezza, consistenza e tempestività.

• Possedere argomenti di produzione end-to-end: gestire le priorità con le parti interessate, strozzature anticipate e garantire una consegna affidabile durante i periodi di punta.

• Contribuire a rafforzare la robustezza della produzione attraverso miglioramenti di processo in corso.

• Partecipa a un ruolo fondamentale nella migrazione dei report esistenti alla Vermilion Reporting Suite (VRS) e alla transizione dei nostri dati a Snowflake.

Miglioramento dell'esperienza cliente

• Migliorare la soddisfazione del cliente aumentando gli standard di qualità e la reattività di servizio.

• Coinvolgere report, modelli e contenuti per migliorare le informazioni sugli investimenti, aumentare la chiarezza, storytelling e impatto visivo per i nostri clienti.

• Partner con i team di Vendite e Investimenti per riunioni/recensioni dei clienti e tradurre feedback in miglioramenti concreti nel reporting delle pratiche di output e di servizio.

Rapporto sull'innovazione

Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people.

The Compliance function is responsible for helping Pictet’s senior management manage the compliance risks faced by Pictet. This role will focus on the risks faced by Pictet’s Singapore bank, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch.

The AML/CFT Compliance Officer is part of the team that oversees the Bank’s financial crime framework, focused primarily on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance. The incumbent performs systematic AML/CFT reviews on high-risk clients before onboarding and subsequent periodic reviews, reviews alerts/issues escalated by first-line functions and reports suspicions of criminal or sanctioned activity, and provides advice on AML/CFT and sanctions management. . The officer monitors changes that may impact the business, working with business and support functions to ensure that the Bank complies with regulatory obligations and Group standards in the financial crime area. The role will report to the Compliance AML Lead.

Your role

Key responsibilities

-Investigate relevant alerts and suspicious activities, and perform filing of STR to local authorities.
-Perform ex-ante AML reviews on high-risk client onboarding and periodic reviews.
-Review escalated alerts from first-line transaction monitoring, payment filtering and ongoing name screening controls.
-Support external requests include production orders, due diligence queries and any relevant regulatory reporting (e.g. Remote Gambling Act reporting).
-Act as an expert advisor to business and support functions on compliance and regulatory matters related to AML/CFT and international sanctions management.
-Perform an annual AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) identifying risks and framework/control gaps to the attention of management and Group -Compliance.
-Assist with periodical risk-based design and operating effectiveness testing of first-line AML/CFT controls, including on lower-risk clients.
-Represent Compliance as needed on financial crime related projects and initiatives.
-Assist in the resolution of Compliance-owned management action plans from audits, inspections and Group reviews.
-Produce relevant management information reports to board and senior management on the governance of financial crime risks.
-Build and maintain a proactive and constructive relationship with business and functional stakeholders to ensure appropriate controls are in place for financial crime risk identification and management.
-Keep abreast and understand the impact of new financial crime regulations and where needed, represent the Bank in industry consultations.
-Support the Singapore AML Lead on all AML/CFT matters and any other duties as assigned.

Your profile

-Bachelor Degree in law, banking or business.
-Working knowledge of the CDSA, AML/CFT typologies, relevant MAS Regulations and Guidance on AML/CFT and the international sanctions framework.
-Working experience of Singapore regulatory landscape and expectations needed. Familiarity with regulations and guidance in an AML, Financial crime Compliance role.
-6-10 years of relevant experience in AML/CFT compliance particularly on investigations.
-Prior experience in a similar role in a Private Bank will be advantageous.
-Highly effective verbal and written communication and organizational skills.

-Ability to multi-task competing priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
-Capable of working with cross-functional and senior stakeholders.
-Sense of accountability, good time management and ability to meet tight deadlines.

Business Compliace Manager

The successful candidate will join a team whose principal function is to analyse and perform control activities related to anti-money laundering (AML) and business risks.

• Reviewing new account applications for compliance with KYC requirements.

• Completing risk ratings of new accounts.

• Periodic reviews of existing customer accounts.

• Identification and review of unusual transactions.

• Review and analysis of name screening alerts.

• Reporting of key performamce indicators.

Your profile

• Strong analytical skills.

• Ability to work independently and under pressure to meet strict deadlines.

• Must be a team player.

• Excellent oral and written communication skills.

• Excellent problem solving and organizational skills.

• Excellent research and analytical skills.

• Proficiency in a variety of software applications including Microsoft Office.

• At least five (5) years compliance or audit experience in a Private Bank or Trust Company.

• University degree (Banking, Finance, Law, Business Administration or a related field).

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

As part of the Client Register team , you will contribute to the management and integrity of client data, supporting the bank’s core operations and ensuring a high standard of service for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams, without direct contact with clients.

Your main responsibilities will include managing the opening and closing of customer accounts for the bank and its branches, as well as handling credit card administration for customers. This involves updating static data and the services selected by our clients and performing “Cotation” tasks such as signature verification.

In addition, you will play a central role in the transformation of our activities by driving the identification, implementation, and optimization of automation and digitalization solutions for our processes. You will ensure strict adherence to internal procedures and regulatory requirements, while supporting the various business lines of the Bank.

Your role

• Play a key role in managing client account openings and updates for individuals, legal entities, and trusts, ensuring a seamless client experience.

• Strive for excellence in data quality and completeness, supporting both business growth and regulatory requirements.

• Take charge of credit card administration, working closely with service providers to deliver efficient solutions.

• Perform analysis of account structures and verification of client signatures to ensure the validity and compliance of payment instructions.

• Make a real impact by contributing to data remediation initiatives and maintaining accurate client records.

• Be proactive in improving departmental procedures, keeping us aligned with the latest industry standards.

• Embrace digital transformation by supporting the adoption of automation and AI solutions.

• Foster consistency and efficiency by promoting process harmonization across the Group.

• Get involved in projects that drive innovation and enhance client data management.

• Collaborate with dedicated colleagues and key stakeholders across the business.

• Be a valued partner, responding to requests from all business lines regarding Client Register activities.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree, ideally complemented by initial experience in the banking sector (Operations)

Soft skills:

• Meticulous, detail-oriented, and organized, delivering work of the highest quality.

• Dynamic, proactive in problem-solving, and demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit.

• Able to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.

• Discreet and able to handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost professionalism.

Technical skills:

• Proficient in standard MS Office products.

• Interest in automation, digitalization, and new technologies, with the ability to design, maintain, or improve automated operational tools (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, AI agents, etc.), while adhering to security and compliance standards is a strong asset.

Language skills:

• Fluent in written and spoken French. Good command of English. German is an asset.

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Organisation & Digital, Risk and Tax departments.

The Corporate Compliance Officer participates in monitoring the company's activities to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and also takes part in the implementation of the CMP (Control Monitoring Plan). He also ensures the strengthening of the company's procedural and training framework.

Your role

• Analyze regulatory watch screenings performing gap analysis on new regulations and assess their potential impact within the company.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of the Compliance Monitoring Plan by identifying applicable compliance standards and monitoring controls using a risk-based approach.

• Identify and assess compliance risks to which the company is exposed, make appropriate observations, and verify appropriate follow up on related to identified issues with the different stakeholders.

• Assist in establishing and maintaining a compliance manual, ensuring that all internal policies and procedures comply with legal requirements and group minimum standards.

• Assist in the training of new employees on compliance topics and ensure that compliance training is conducted at defined intervals.

• Participate in regulatory projects by providing advice on legal requirements and ensuring that delivered solutions comply with regulations and minimum group standards.

• Maintain and update various registers, including investor complaints, conflicts of interest, personal transactions, gifts, and identified issues.

• Follow up on audit recommendations and participate in the proper implementation.

• Collaborate with regulators and the Ministry of Finance to ensure compliance and respond to regulatory requests.

Your profile

Request experience:

• Bachelor or Master degree in compliance, legal or related field.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a equivalent role.

Technical skills:

• Good knowledge of European and Luxembourgish regulations.

• Understanding of the operational mechanisms of a management company and the associated regulatory framework.

• Good knowledge of the industry of Fund and Asset Management.

• Ability to perform controls. Former experience on audit (external or internal) is a plus.

• Written and oral communication skills.

Soft skills:

• Discretion, rigor, and reliability.

• Analytical skills and critical thinking.

• Good organizational and priority management skills.

• Ability to navigate complex and constantly evolving environments

Language skills:

• French: fluent

• English: fluent

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

jobs.description:
Your team

We are an independent investment partnership known for our long-term mindset, responsible approach to business, and entrepreneurial spirit. These principles have defined us since 1805. For our clients, colleagues and wider society, we always aim to do the right thing and honour our commitment to enduring quality.

Pictet opened its Tokyo office in 1981 to conduct research on the Japanese economy and equity market. It began providing asset management services to institutional investors in 1987 and entered the investment trust (mutual fund) business in 1997. As of the end of March 2026, the firm’s assets under management totaled 4.56 trillion yen.

Your role

We are seeking an economist to lead our global research and analysis on macroeconomics, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange.

Key responsibilities include preparing reports and presentation materials on macroeconomic and financial market developments; delivering presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media; and providing clear explanations and interpretive support during client meetings.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills and excellent communication abilities, with the proven ability to convey complex information effectively in both English and Japanese.

Responsibilities

• Conduct in-depth analysis of macroeconomic trends, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange in Japan and globally

• Prepare reports and presentation materials for both internal and external stakeholders

• Deliver presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media

• Provide clear explanations and interpretation support during client meetings

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree or higher

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as an economist

• Deep understanding of macroeconomics and financial markets

• Native-level proficiency in Japanese and business-level or higher proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking)

• Excellent report writing and presentation skills

• Demonstrated experience in client-facing roles

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Certified Member Analyst of the Securities Analysts Association of Japan (CMA) or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)

• Bloomberg

Die Partner-eigene Finanzdienstleistungsgruppe bietet einen umfassenden Service für wohlhabende Einzelpersonen und Familien, einschließlich diskretionärer und beratender Anlagelösungen und Family Office-Services.

Deine Rolle

Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Finanzanalysten, der sich unserem Asia 2-Team im Rahmen eines einzigartigen, strukturierten 4-Jahres-Rotationsprogramms anschließt, das eine umfassende Grundlage im Private Banking und Investment Management bietet.

Am Ende dieses Programms werden Sie in die Lage versetzt, die Rolle des Privatbankers zu übernehmen, unterstützt von einem robusten internen Netzwerk von Spezialisten und einem Verständnis für unser Geschäft und unsere Kunden.

Diese feste Position bietet eine 48-monatige Reise durch drei Schlüsselbereiche unseres Wealth Management-Geschäfts, so dass Sie Fachwissen aufbauen und ein starkes professionelles Netzwerk aufbauen können:

Jahr 1: Immersion mit Client Relationship Officers, um das Kundenbeziehungsmanagement und den täglichen Betrieb zu entdecken.

• Jahre 2 & 3: Integration in die Investmentplattform, um Ihr Wissen über Investment- und Portfoliomanagement zu vertiefen und die Bedürfnisse von Portfoliomanagern zu verstehen.

• Jahr 4: Sammeln von praktischen Erfahrungen in der hochrangigen Vermögensverwaltung durch die Verwaltung eines bestehenden Kundenportfolios.

Während des gesamten Programms werden Sie von einem Senior Banker betreut und arbeiten mit Fachleuten aus dem gesamten Bankensektor zusammen, unterstützen die Umsetzung von Vermögensverwaltungsstrategien und tragen zur Bereitstellung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen für unsere Kunden bei. Sie haben auch die Möglichkeit, professionelle Zertifizierungen wie den CFA abzuschließen und an laufenden Schulungs- und Entwicklungsaktivitäten teilzunehmen.

Dein Profil

• Master- oder Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen oder Management mit 3 bis 5 Jahren Berufserfahrung.
• Begeisterung, zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und ein starkes Interesse an Kundenbeziehungen.
• Hoch organisiert, detailorientiert und in der Lage, mehrere Projekte mit konkurrierenden Fristen zu verwalten.
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl schriftlich als auch verbal.
• Teamplayer mit einer positiven Einstellung, einer starken Arbeitsmoral und der Fähigkeit, sich schnell anzupassen.

Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) combine plus de 200 ans d'héritage bancaire suisse avec une expertise en investissement mondial. Le groupe de services financiers appartenant aux partenaires offre un service complet aux personnes et aux familles fortunées, y compris des solutions d'investissement discrétionnaires et consultatives et des services de bureau familial.

Votre rôle

Nous recherchons un analyste financier très motivé pour rejoindre notre équipe Asia 2 dans le cadre d'un programme de rotation de 4 ans unique et structuré conçu pour fournir une base complète dans la banque privée et la gestion des investissements.

A la fin de ce programme, vous serez équipé pour assumer le rôle de Private Banker, soutenu par un solide réseau interne de spécialistes et une compréhension de notre entreprise et de nos clients.

Cette position permanente offre un voyage de 48 mois dans trois domaines clés de notre activité Gestion de patrimoine, vous permettant de développer une expertise et de développer un solide réseau professionnel:

• Année 4: acquérir une expérience pratique en matière de conseil en gestion de patrimoine de haut niveau grâce à la gestion d'un portefeuille de clients existant.
